action: Text Robert Jackson with the specific information he asked for: the community college CNA program runs 16 weeks, costs roughly $2,800, and has a clinical placement component that connects directly to hospital hiring. Patient transport (NEMT certification) is faster — about 40 hours of training — and you can bill through Medicaid if you get the right vehicle certification, which makes it a real bridge income. The workforce retraining grant I applied for has a 6-8 week decision window; I have not heard back yet but the application is in.
